title: Тайлмапы в 2D-играх

units.title: Добавление тайлмапа
requirements: 2D-project, Scenes folder and saved scene. One Grid with Background and Platforms child Tilemaps; do not create a second Grid. Grid default Cell Size=(1,1,0), Tilemap+TilemapRenderer on each.

units.title: Создание палитры
requirements: Persist real palette assets Jungle Tiles and Grass Tiles in Palettes, both accessible in Tile Palette window.

units.title: Настройка спрайтов и создание тайлов
requirements: Sprites folder. GrassPlatform_Tileset SpriteMode=Multiple, PPU=64, Slice GridByCellSize64x64. Jungle_Tileset sliced128x128; corresponding PPU must match tile size per CellSize1 (text says repeat settings; inspect original importer/meta before overwriting). Preserve every source sprite and create real Tile assets in Tiles; put correct tiles into respective Grass Tiles/Jungle Tiles palettes.

units.title: Рисуем тайлами
requirements: Paint Jungle background and Grass platforms into their own maps. Scene must contain recognizable textured terrain rather than solid square substitutes. Arrange tiles inside palettes for practical editing.

units.title: Тайлмапы и физика
requirements: Import real CharacterRobotBoy above platform, scale=(1,1,1) if needed. TilemapCollider2D on Platforms, offset.y=-0.1. Add CompositeCollider2D with Rigidbody2D BodyType=Static, enable UsedByComposite on TilemapCollider2D. Consider Continuous collision for fast actor.

units.title: Итоговое упражнение
requirements: Finish both painted maps; optional Foreground plants/rocks; follow camera via CameraFollow.cs; move Background farther on z and use perspective camera to show real parallax; tint Background paler.

required_checks: After save/reopen all sprite, Tile, palette references survive.
Robot lands on grass and can jump between platforms; collision offset correct; composite map static.
Follow camera and actual parallax under motion, layer sorting correct.
old_scaffold_defects: Prior scene used single-color generated square sprites; no imported tile sheets, no real palettes.
Called maps Ground/Decoration instead of Platforms/Foreground; omitted original RobotBoy, composite collider and offset.
